title: Which founder superpower would you pick?
intro: You only get one. What you reach for says which part of this you find hardest, which is more interesting than the power itself.
og_line: Five questions and the power you would actually choose.

cta.title: Something a bit more serious
cta.label: The Energy Discovery
cta.blurb: That one was for fun. The Energy Discovery is 48 statements and returns how you actually work across all twelve energies.

questions.q: The most frustrating part of last month:

options.a: Sitting on a decision too long
Being the only one who could do it

questions.q: When you are stuck, you usually:

options.a: Nothing. I need to hear it directly
Anything, I just need the hours
Everything, if it were done my way
You really understood what I needed
I do not know how you do it all
Building for a year, nobody wants it
Falling behind and not catching up
Watching someone else do the thing I hesitated on
The market moves and I am the last to know
Being off for a week and it all stops

results.name: Read your customers minds
results.headline: You want to stop guessing.
results.body: The part you find hardest is not building, it is knowing what to build. You would trade a lot to skip the guessing.
results.cost: You would stop asking people things, and asking is how you learn to read them without a power.

results.name: Unlimited energy
results.headline: You want the day to be longer.
results.body: You know exactly what to do. There is simply more of it than there are hours, and that is the whole problem.
results.cost: Unlimited energy would let you keep doing the wrong thing for much longer.

results.name: Never fear failure
results.headline: You want the hesitation gone.
results.body: You have known the right move before and not made it. The gap between knowing and doing is where your time goes.
results.cost: A little fear is the thing that makes you check the numbers first.

results.name: See market trends coming
results.headline: You want to stop being surprised.
results.body: You would rather be early than fast. Being caught out by something you could have seen is the one that stings.
results.cost: Knowing what is coming and acting on it are different skills.

results.name: Clone yourself
results.headline: You want to stop being the bottleneck.
results.body: Nothing moves without you. You would rather duplicate the standard than explain it.
results.cost: A clone is delegation for people who do not want to teach.
